name: laulamanapps/document-signer-sdk
description: Provider-agnostic e-signature SDK for PHP: build envelopes from HTML templates with {[type:signer:name]} placeholders, render them to PDF, and send them through any SignatureProvider implementation (ValidSign, DocuSign, or your own).

suggest.spatie/browsershot: Required to use the bundled BrowsershotPdfRenderer (default PDF renderer).
